mandatoryCriteria: Session-derived authorization: Every request derives active actor identity, workspace ownership, and project memberships strictly from verified server session
Owner authority inheritance: Workspace owner inherits automatic full administrative authority over all projects in the workspace
Project-scoped manager authority: Project Manager authority is strictly confined to their granted project; manager has zero administrative power in sibling projects
Member and viewer privilege boundaries: Member cannot perform administration, invite users, or trash cards; viewer has read-only access to granted project
Sibling project privacy: Accessing an ungranted project returns uniform 404 NOT_FOUND with zero information disclosure
No insecure development bypass: dev-login and test helpers are not accessible in production and do not bypass session or role checks
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Core role resolution, workspace owner inheritance, project manager scoping, member/viewer limits, and sibling privacy middleware on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: Entity-specific child resource ancestry checking is handled in RBAC-02.
